content:
Anne K: quick heads-up — while updating the onboarding checklist I hit a 404 in the KB. The page /kb/deploy/production-runbook.md includes an external anchor that returns 404. Can someone own a quick fix?
Samir G: which anchor/url exactly? I can take a look in a few.
Anne K: the link is to our old runbook service: https://runbook.internal.company.com/ops#db-migrations — sounds like the external host was sunset. Here's the snippet: 
```
See the full ops runbook: [Runbook](https://runbook.internal.company.com/ops#db-migrations)
```
Riya Patel: @Samir G @Mike Liao I think we should either update to the new docs link or convert to an internal redirect. Samir — if you can't, I can make a quick PR.
Samir G: pinging if nobody else picks this up. I have a meeting in 30 but can do a small patch after. If it's urgent, Riya go for it.
Mike Liao: tagging docs ownership: the page has frontmatter owner: "platform" but I don't see an active owner team. Could we reassign to infra-docs?
DocsBot: Automated scan alert: 1 broken external link detected in /kb/deploy/production-runbook.md (checked at 2026-11-02T09:12:00Z). Suggestion: replace with canonical /runbooks/production-db.md or remove anchor.
Riya Patel: thanks @DocsBot — I'll open a PR to replace with /runbooks/production-db.md and add a redirect note. Planning small change: update link + add owner: "infra-docs" in frontmatter.
Anne K: sounds great. Also request: can we add a tiny note for readers that db migration steps moved? saves confusion.
Riya Patel: will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — includes link update, frontmatter owner change, and one-liner note.
Samir G: quick code review request — @Mike Liao can you glance? I can review after my meeting.
Mike Liao: will look in ~45. If no blocker, please merge. :thumbsup:
Anne K: thanks team! Leaving this here for async follow-up — LMK if you want me to run a search for other references to runbook.internal.company.com.
Riya Patel: please do, Anne. I can add a quick grep workflow to the repo to catch similar dead hosts.
Samir G: nice. If anyone finds more, drop them in this thread and I'll batch fixes.
Mike Liao: noted. closing loop once PR merged.
DocsBot: PR linked: #4821 — Recommended labels: docs, low-priority, redirect.
